@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Thick grey smoke comes out of the factory c______y all the time, and the residents in the area often complain about it.
= chimney
~詞義 chimney（n.）煙囪
~原文 Thick grey smoke comes out of the factory chimney all the time, and the residents in the area often complain about it.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The bathtub is very full, so please turn off the f______t.
= faucet
~詞義 faucet（n.）水龍頭
~原文 The bathtub is very full, so please turn off the faucet.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The brave knight raised his s______d high and brought it down on the beast's neck.
= sword
~詞義 sword（n.）劍
~原文 The brave knight raised his sword high and brought it down on the beast's neck.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This morning, Amy went to the bank and withdrew some money from her a______t.
= account
~詞義 account（n.）帳戶
~原文 This morning, Amy went to the bank and withdrew some money from her account.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The ground is very s______y because it just rained. Be careful where you step, or you may fall.
= slippery
~詞義 slippery（adj.）滑的
~原文 The ground is very slippery because it just rained. Be careful where you step, or you may fall.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Andy's ankle had ______ so badly after the fall that the school nurse insisted he visit a doctor immediately.
A: frozen
B: swollen
C: glowed
D: proven
= B
~詞義 swollen（adj.）腫大
~原文 Andy's ankle had swollen so badly after the fall that the school nurse insisted he visit a doctor immediately.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Vivian has become a ______ to her phone because she checks messages constantly instead of focusing on real conversations.
A: skate
B: pearl
C: slave
D: chip
= C
~詞義 slave（n.）奴隸
~原文 Vivian has become a slave to her phone because she checks messages constantly instead of focusing on real conversations.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There is a lot of ______ going around about Jessica and her boyfriend, but none of it is true.
A: evidence
B: gossip
C: headline
D: voter
= B
~詞義 gossip（n.）流言蜚語
~原文 There is a lot of gossip going around about Jessica and her boyfriend, but none of it is true.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There is a sale on right now—you can get a ______ if you buy more than three pieces of clothing at once.
A: razor
B: snapshot
C: punch
D: discount
= D
~詞義 discount（n.）折扣
~原文 There is a sale on right now—you can get a discount if you buy more than three pieces of clothing at once.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: It is the best feeling in the world to have chocolate ______ in your mouth.
A: melt
B: swear
C: skip
D: vote
= A
~詞義 melt（v.）融化
~原文 It is the best feeling in the world to have chocolate melt in your mouth.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: summit
B: proof
C: swiftly
D: snapping
E: sweat
F: slipping

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jenny apologized after ______ at her friend, admitting she was worried about deadlines and hadn't slept well.
= D
~詞義 snap（v.）大聲說話;發怒
~原文 Jenny apologized after snapping at her friend, admitting she was worried about deadlines and hadn't slept well.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The baseball game has lasted for more than three hours, and the players are all covered in ______ and dirt.
= E
~詞義 sweat（n.）汗水
~原文 The baseball game has lasted for more than three hours, and the players are all covered in sweat and dirt.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: After hours of hiking, we finally got to the ______ of the mountain.
= A
~詞義 summit（n.）峰頂
~原文 After hours of hiking, we finally got to the summit of the mountain.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: This company's latest motorcycle can move around very ______ and silently.
= C
~詞義 swiftly（adv.）迅速地
~原文 This company's latest motorcycle can move around very swiftly and silently.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Since there wasn't any ______ that the man had stolen the money, the police had no choice but to let him go.
= B
~詞義 proof（n.）證據
~原文 Since there wasn't any proof that the man had stolen the money, the police had no choice but to let him go.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: pub
B: scrubbed
C: rug
D: sealed
E: heap
F: penny

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mandy's room is always very messy. She piles her clothes into a ______ on the floor instead of folding them properly and putting them away.
= E
~詞義 heap（n.）一堆
~原文 Mandy's room is always very messy. She piles her clothes into a heap on the floor instead of folding them properly and putting them away.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: The character in the novel started his journey with nothing, not even a ______ to his name.
= F
~詞義 penny（n.）一貧如洗(not have a penny to one's name)
~原文 The character in the novel started his journey with nothing, not even a penny to his name.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Your boots are covered with mud; they need to be ______ clean.
= B
~詞義 scrub（v.）刷洗
~原文 Your boots are covered with mud; they need to be scrubbed clean.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Frank put a stamp on the envelope and ______ it.
= D
~詞義 seal（v.）密封
~原文 Frank put a stamp on the envelope and sealed it.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The dog was sleeping on the thick, woolen ______ on the floor in front of the fire.
= C
~詞義 rug（n.）小地毯
~原文 The dog was sleeping on the thick, woolen rug on the floor in front of the fire.
